items.problem: CS0104 DispatcherQueue/DispatcherQueuePriority ambiguity between Windows.System and Microsoft.UI.Dispatching blocked the first build (5 errors).
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 47 'error CS0104: DispatcherQueuePriority is an ambiguous reference between Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueuePriority and Windows.System.DispatcherQueuePriority'; lessons.json errors_encountered[0]; skill-defects.json item 1.
items.root_cause: DispatcherQueue and DispatcherQueuePriority exist in both Windows.System (WinRT) and Microsoft.UI.Dispatching; migrated files keep `using Windows.System;` for WinRT APIs, so importing Microsoft.UI.Dispatching makes both names ambiguous. The skill's CS0104 note was scoped to Xaml namespaces only.
items.change: Broadened the CS0104 note and added a boxed warning in the Threading section: do not import Microsoft.UI.Dispatching (the inherited DispatcherQueue instance resolves TryEnqueue), or fully-qualify the priority overload; don't add `using Windows.System;` to get DispatcherQueue.
items.expected_effect: Agent qualifies/omits the Dispatching using on the first pass instead of after a failed build.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any app that dispatches to the UI thread while using Windows.System.* APIs, the build produces 0 CS0104 DispatcherQueue/DispatcherQueuePriority errors.

items.problem: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 + WMC9999 blocked the first build on an x:Bind DataTemplate whose .xaml was present.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 47 'MainPage.xaml(25,30): WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' / 'WMC1111'; fixed turn 51 by switching to {Binding}; skill-defects.json item 2.
items.root_cause: The skill attributed WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 solely to an orphaned code-behind (missing .xaml). The .xaml was present; the real cause was an x:Bind DataTemplate whose x:DataType type could not be resolved via the xmlns prefixes. The x:Bind section only covered XLS0414/MC3074.
items.change: Added a note to the x:Bind section for the .xaml-present WMC0909 cause (unresolvable x:DataType: fix the xmlns prefix to the item type's real namespace or fall back to {Binding}) and a reverse cross-reference from the orphaned-XAML note.
items.expected_effect: Agent distinguishes the two causes of WMC0909 and fixes the DataTemplate directly instead of hunting for a missing .xaml.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run migrating an SDK-sample-style scenario-list app, the build produces 0 WMC0909/WMC1111 errors on the scenario DataTemplate.
